messages.author: f6dea426c8b7a030
messages.subject: returning coordinates on a plot
parts:
I have great admiration for the efforts of the shiny team.

Looking to port an application from tcl/tk.
Wondering this: in my application, a plot is instrumented with a callback
that delivers coordinates on click, that can then
be converted to plotting coordinates. How would you
approach implementing this in shiny?

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: returning coordinates on a plot
parts: Sorry, this isn't currently possible. It would be possible to send the pixel coordinates of the click back, but the plotting device would be long gone by then. We have some ideas for the future in this area but nothing that will help you in the short term.
